name: Fuentes de Andalucía (Spain)
description: Vertically divided blue and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Fuentes de Andalucía (a castle on yellow and a fountain on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Fuentes de Andalucía; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Fuentes de Andalucía arms — castle on yellow and fountain on blue
